commits.subject: Controls slice 1: descriptor registry (number/toggle/choice/color/text), strict legality owner, validated value store with undo-friendly events, descriptor-driven egui renderer, agent JSON + manual projections, dead-control audit
Controls slice 1: 5 focused tests (numeric legality + store/undo, headless egui frames, projection round-trip, orphan audit, descriptor refusal) + controls-consumer example

capabilities_done: ControlSpec descriptors (id,label,unit,help,kind,default) for number(field|slider)/toggle/choice/color/text; Registry with duplicate/invalid refusal and ordered specs

single legality owner on the descriptor: validate_value, strict parse_text (no arithmetic/junk-stripping, exact unit suffix), pointer_value (clamps hard bounds only, crosses soft), step_value (one modifier, rejects at hard bound); four-field bounds always (STU-FX-107); hard violation = OutOfHardBounds naming control, value, both bounds

ValueStore bound to a Registry: every write validated, ChangeEvent{seq,control_id,old,new,source,actor} per accepted change, no event for unchanged value, undo() with Stale refusal, reset, Interaction apply

egui_adapter: one renderer driven only by descriptors (scrub label + slider + typed field with Enter/blur commit, Escape discard, arrow steps; checkbox; combo box; colour button; text field), stable egui ids from control id, inline rejection text, soft-range marker, show_panel / show_panel_and_apply; headless (egui 0.33.3, default_fonts only, no eframe/accesskit/wgpu)

projection: agent_json (deterministic pretty JSON with all four bounds, derived step trio, help, consumers, actions, current value) + registry_from_json (full re-validation) + manual_topics from the same descriptors
dead-control audit: Registry::audit() -> AuditReport{total,consumed,orphans}; register_consumer refuses unknown controls

notes.fine_step_vs_precision: Interpretation recorded for spec enrichment (STU-FX-109/110): precision = declared DISPLAY decimal places only; step=10^-precision, fine_step=step/10 and coarse_step=step*10 are DERIVED, never stored, and fine_step may be finer than the display precision (0.001 at precision 2). Stored/accepted values keep full parsed precision (typed 0.7549 is stored as 0.7549, shown as 0.75); nothing rounds to precision silently. Step arithmetic only strips binary noise (clean(): 1e-9 grid below 1e6).
notes.step_at_hard_bound: Keyboard/accessibility step that would leave the hard range is REJECTED with OutOfHardBounds (not clamped, not a silent no-op); pointer route is the only clamping route (hard bounds only).
notes.modifier_defaults_unverified: Shift = coarse, Alt = fine, applied once, are lead-chosen defaults; STU-FX-149 closed defaults were not read in this slice (UNVERIFIED).
notes.slider_track: Slider track = complete soft pair, else complete hard pair; label drag-scrub (not the slider) is the route that crosses soft bounds up to the hard clamp (STU-FX-110a).
notes.dep_requests: builders/dep-requests.jsonl: egui =0.33.3 (default-features=false, features=[default_fonts]; no eframe/accesskit/wgpu; default_fonts needed because Context::run lays out text), serde =1.0.229 (std,derive), serde_json =1.0.151 (std). accord is an allowed path edge (ActorContext on ChangeEvent). observe edge not used yet.
notes.serde_json_float: serde_json default float parsing is exact for <=15 significant digits (tests use such values); no float_roundtrip feature enabled.
known_gaps: drag gestures emit one Interaction per frame: no gesture-end/coalescing marker for undo grouping yet
no AccessKit projection / accesskit feature (descriptor already carries role-relevant fields: label, value, min, max, step)
no Observe reporting of outcomes (report(&Outcome ...) from brief step 6)
no integer domain, no panels/docking/gizmos/swatches, no pointer resistance (STU-SHL-192)
ChangeEvent/Interaction are in-process types (not serde); document commit remains with the host actor
egui widget rendering is verified headless only via value/interaction outcomes; no pixel/visual proof
